"""Independent round506 whole finite gate, all original data and source.

Only this reviewer's prior exact code is reused. No author checker or search
is imported or run. All new target data are rebuilt with Fraction.
"""
from pathlib import Path
from fractions import Fraction as Q
import contextlib,hashlib,io,json,time
import independent_outer_audit as base
import independent_new_frame_audit as fresh

started=time.perf_counter()
cert_path=base.ROOT/'tmp/research-round506-20261011/proportion/am-outer-frame-certificate.json'
checker_path=cert_path.with_name('am_outer_frame_certificate.py')
assert base.sha(cert_path)=='04f61dbc3913d11ce6da0bfea9e569ca2cd659ae19fdf095281b0b86174e7810'
assert base.sha(checker_path)=='ef68ab57e81113f4f2a0174da9c2bd869d06ae12aa460f2aa5394de78ef7db38'
cert=base.load(cert_path)
assert cert['schema']=='rh-weil-am-outer-frame-506-v1'
assert Q(cert['global_F8_reward'])==base.FLOOR and Q(cert['uniform_F9_reward'])==base.TARGET
assert cert['original_source_raw_sha256']==base.pub['original_source_raw_sha256']
assert cert['region']==base.region and cert['original_point_count']==2196
for name,pin in cert['dependency_canonical_lf_sha256'].items():
    assert base.sha(base.ROOT/name)==pin,(name,pin)
adapter_raw=(json.dumps(cert['base33_adapter'],indent=2)+'\n').encode('utf-8')
assert hashlib.sha256(adapter_raw).hexdigest()==cert['base33_adapter_raw_sha256']=='6871cc80f90aea753ac9db95321f6f6099a4b50fbe2fd2494e475251eb8140ec'
assert cert['base33_adapter']==base.adapter
points={p:(pack,n) for p,pack,n in cert['point_catalog']}
assert len(points)==len(cert['point_catalog'])
assert all(base.points[p]==v for p,v in points.items())
values={};frame_records=[]
for record in cert['base33_adapter']['records']:
    label=record['label'];assert record['added_rows']==[]
    prob=base.matrix(base.old['captured_cells'][label],[])
    assert record['base_rows']==prob[4]
    assert Q(record['original_YA_exact'])==base.paid(base.old['captured_cells'][label])
    value=base.dual(prob,record['dual_sparse'])
    assert value==Q(record['lower_exact'])>=base.FLOOR
    values[label]=value;frame_records.append({'label':label,'route':'base33_adapter','value':str(value)})
assert len(values)==201
patches={r['label']:r for r in cert['frame_patches']}
assert len(patches)==5 and set(patches)=={17,69,74,131,183}
retained=0
for record in base.pub['frame_patches']:
    label=record['label']
    if label in patches:continue
    prob=base.matrix(base.old['captured_cells'][label],record['added_rows'])
    assert record['base_rows']==prob[4]
    value=base.dual(prob,record['dual_sparse'])
    assert value==Q(record['lower_exact'])>=base.FLOOR
    assert label not in values;values[label]=value;retained+=1
    frame_records.append({'label':label,'route':'retained_505','value':str(value)})
assert retained==35
new_cases=[];used=set();rowcount=dualcount=0
for label,record in patches.items():
    cell=base.old['captured_cells'][label];span=record['span'];d=fresh.exact_closure(cell)
    expected=[-d[span[1]][span[0]],d[span[0]][span[1]]]
    assert record['original_bounds_5sc']==expected
    bs=record['branches']
    assert bs and bs[0]['bounds_5sc'][0]==expected[0] and bs[-1]['bounds_5sc'][1]==expected[1]
    assert all(a['bounds_5sc'][1]==b['bounds_5sc'][0] for a,b in zip(bs,bs[1:]))
    local=[]
    for index,br in enumerate(bs):
        prob=fresh.problem(cell,br,span,br['bounds_5sc'],False)
        if prob is None:
            new_cases.append({'label':label,'branch':index,'empty_negative_cycle_verified':True});continue
        value=base.dual(prob,br['dual_sparse'])
        assert value==Q(br['lower'])>=base.FLOOR
        local.append(value);rowcount+=len(br['added_rows']);dualcount+=len(br['dual_sparse'])
        used.update((x[3],x[4],x[5]) for x in br['added_rows'] if x[0]=='tangent')
        new_cases.append({'label':label,'branch':index,'value':str(value),'margin':str(value-base.FLOOR)})
    assert local and min(local)==Q(record['lower'])
    assert label not in values;values[label]=min(local)
    frame_records.append({'label':label,'route':'new_closed_cover','value':str(min(local))})
assert set(values)==set(range(241)) and len(new_cases)==17
assert used=={(p,pack,n) for p,(pack,n) in points.items()}
# Repeat the independent full inherited raw reconstruction and exhaustive
# 482^2 domain enumeration. It is reviewer's code, not author's generator.
prior_receipt=base.FORMAL/'verification/joint-frame-pair-independent-formal-data-review.json'
prior=base.load(prior_receipt)
program=prior['independent_execution']['script_source']
assert hashlib.sha256(program.encode()).hexdigest()=='c5dd1fd3baed2c36efe2c323d00a393c8a3f32901d3590c0b33e9dc07d537c89'
ns={}
with contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):exec(program,ns)
pair_records=ns['pairvalues']+ns['oldresults']
formal_pairmin=min(Q(r['lower']) for r in pair_records)
assert all(Q(r['lower'])>base.TARGET for r in pair_records)
full_old=[]
patched_domains={(r['left'],r['right']) for r in ns['pairinputs']}
assert len(patched_domains)==57
for index,record in enumerate(ns['old']['pairs']):
    if (record['left'],record['right']) in patched_domains:continue
    a,b=record['left'],record['right']
    rows=ns['base_cache'][a,0]+ns['base_cache'][b,1]
    for ex in record['extra_points']:
        i,j=ex['span'];offset=ex['offset'];p,pack=ex['point'],ex['pack'];label=a if offset==0 else b
        lo,hi=ns['tight'](label,i,j)
        for side in (False,True):rows.append(ns['cutrow'](i+offset,j+offset,p,pack,5*min(lo,p),5*max(hi,p),side))
    multipliers=[(i,int(Q(v)*10**9)) for i,v in record['dual_sparse']]
    d=ns['floyd']([[ns['pairprimitive'](a,b,i,j) for j in range(9)] for i in range(9)])
    value=Q(ns['integer_lower'](rows,multipliers,d,False,10**9),2*ns['SA']*ns['KS']*10**9)
    assert value==Q(record['lower'])
    full_old.append({'index':index,'left':a,'right':b,'lower':str(value)})
assert len(full_old)==2342
pairmin=min(Q(r['lower']) for r in ns['pairvalues']+full_old)
assert pairmin==Q(32992055894668884928258784247,4096000000000000000000000000000)
assert ns['results']['old_literal_fidelity']['physical_combinations_exhausted']==482**2
assert ns['results']['old_literal_fidelity']['Floyd_feasible']==2399
assert ns['results']['pair_cover']['patches']==57 and ns['results']['pair_cover']['branches']==104
strong=Q(cert['strong_reward']);minimum=min(values.values())
safe=(strong+base.FLOOR)/2;exact=(strong+minimum)/2
assert safe==base.TARGET and exact>base.TARGET and pairmin>base.TARGET
ratio=Q(66812491,10**8)/(1-base.TARGET)
assert ratio==Q(66812491,99194540)
assert (Q(51,550))**2>base.TARGET
result={'status':'PASS independent complete finite arithmetic and unchanged analytic-consumption scope',
  'ran_author_code':False,'ran_Lean':False,'ran_Nano':False,'website_accepted':False,
  'target_F8':str(base.FLOOR),'target_F9':str(base.TARGET),'simple_critical_ratio':str(ratio),
  'base33_adapter_count':201,'retained_505_frame_count':35,'new_case_count':17,'total_frame_cases':253,
  'original_frame_labels':241,'reflected_labels':241,'new_used_original_points':len(points),
  'new_added_rows':rowcount,'new_positive_dual_coefficients':dualcount,
  'new_closed_endpoint_covers':5,'all_frame_records':frame_records,'new_cases':new_cases,
  'minimum_frame':str(minimum),'minimum_frame_labels':[i for i,v in values.items() if v==minimum],
  'minimum_pair':str(pairmin),'physical_domains':2399,'patches':57,'closed_pair_branches':104,
  'weaker_formal_basic_path_pair_minimum_also_above_new_target':str(formal_pairmin),
  'old_domains':2342,'full_physical_enumeration':ns['results']['old_literal_fidelity'],
  'safe_outer':str(safe),'exact_outer':str(exact),'strict_outer_margin':str(exact-base.TARGET),
  'strict_pair_margin':str(pairmin-base.TARGET),
  'gain_percentage_points_exact':str(100*(ratio-Q(66812491,99194552))),
  'analytic_scope':'unchanged actual all-zero AM transport: normalized separated Gram<2, near pair, 32 eta n smoothing, 8c endpoints; fixed error before eventual T; actual N0simple/Ncount dyadic and cumulative. New target has no new Lean/Nano receipt.',
  'input_pins':{str(p):base.sha(p) for p in [cert_path,checker_path,prior_receipt,
      Path(__file__),Path(base.__file__),Path(fresh.__file__)]},
  'elapsed_seconds':time.perf_counter()-started}
(base.WORK/'final-outer-independent-audit.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in result.items() if k not in ('all_frame_records','new_cases','input_pins')},indent=2))

independent_outer_audit.py.script_source:
"""Independent exact audit of stored round505 outer witnesses; no author import.

LP primal points are optional diagnostics for a specified finite relaxation.
They cannot be read as an upper bound for AM energy or actual zeta counts.
"""
from pathlib import Path
from fractions import Fraction as Q
import ast, json, re, hashlib, time

ROOT = Path(r'E:\codex-build\RH-Weil')
FORMAL = Path(r'E:\codex-build\RH-Zero-Proportion-Formalization')
WORK = ROOT / 'tmp/research-round506-20261011/audit'
SC, SA = 32768, 10**8
FLOOR = Q(805117, SA)
TARGET = Q(805460, SA)

def load(p):
    return json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))

def sha(p):
    return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes().replace(b'\r\n', b'\n').replace(b'\r', b'\n')).hexdigest()

def literal(p, name):
    tree = ast.parse(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    return ast.literal_eval(next(x.value for x in tree.body if isinstance(x, ast.Assign)
        and any(isinstance(a, ast.Name) and a.id == name for a in x.targets)))

weights = literal(ROOT/'scripts/am_lossless_majorant_certificate.py', 'ROWS')
fees = literal(ROOT/'scripts/am_lossless_majorant_certificate.py', 'BS')
terms = [(i,j,weights[i][j-i-1]) for i in range(7) for j in range(i+1,8) if weights[i][j-i-1]]
longspans = [(i,j) for i in range(6) for j in range(i+2,8)]
assert len(terms) == 26 and len(longspans) == 21
assert fees == fees[::-1]
assert {(i,j):v for i,j,v in terms} == {(7-j,7-i):v for i,j,v in terms}
old = load(ROOT/'output/am-expanded-nine-point-certificate.json')
pub = load(ROOT/'output/am-joint-frame-pair-certificate.json')
adapter = load(FORMAL/'output/am-joint-frame-ya-adapter.json')
points, region = {}, None
source = ROOT/'tmp/pc8-am-admission/Solution.lean'
assert hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == pub['original_source_raw_sha256']
for line in source.read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines():
    m = re.fullmatch(r'def PTL_(\d+) \(x : ℕ\) : ℕ := ptl (.+) x', line)
    if m:
        for p, pack in ast.literal_eval(m[2]):
            assert p not in points
            points[p] = pack, int(m[1])
    if line.startswith('def REG : '):
        region = list(ast.literal_eval(line.split(':=', 1)[1].strip())[:2])
assert len(points) == 2196 and region == pub['region'] == old['region']

def fields(pack):
    return pack % (2**32), (pack >> 32) % (2**32), pack >> 64

def mode_weights(k,m):
    return (0,1024,0) if k == 1 else (1024-m,m,0) if k == 2 else (0,1024-m,m) if k == 3 else (1024,0,0)

def paid(cell):
    L, U = cell['gap_bounds'][::2], cell['gap_bounds'][1::2]
    cr = [1024 * 10**9 * b for b in fees]
    b = 10240000000000 * sum(x*y for x,y in zip(fees,L))
    for (i,j,a), atom in zip(terms, cell['atoms']):
        mode, mixture, p, r, l, up, l0, lb, pp, rp = atom
        c,w1,w2 = mode_weights(mode,mixture)
        v, msl, mw, mc = c*lb, 0, 0, 0
        for wt,pt,pk in [(w1,p,pp),(w2,r,rp)]:
            value,plus,minus = fields(pk)
            v += wt*value
            msl += wt*plus
            mw += wt
            mc += wt*(minus-2*10**9)*max(pt-l0,0)
        b += SC*a*v + 10*a*mc
        for t in range(i,j):
            cr[t] += a*(msl-2*10**9*mw)
    p,s,cp,cm = cell['ya'][:7],cell['ya'][7:14],cell['ya'][14],cell['ya'][15]
    return Q(b+10*(cm-cp)-10*sum((up-lo)*max(-(co+sv-pv),0)
        for up,lo,co,sv,pv in zip(U,L,cr,s,p)),335544320000000000*SA)

def constraints(cell):
    a,b = cell['gap_bounds'],cell['span_bounds']
    out = {(i,i+1):(5*a[2*i],5*a[2*i+1]) for i in range(7)}
    out.update({s:(5*b[2*k],5*b[2*k+1]) for k,s in enumerate(longspans)})
    return out

def closure(cell, branch=None):
    d = [[0 if i==j else 10**30 for j in range(8)] for i in range(8)]
    for (i,j),(lo,hi) in constraints(cell).items():
        d[i][j] = min(d[i][j],hi)
        d[j][i] = min(d[j][i],-lo)
    if branch:
        (i,j),(lo,hi) = branch
        d[i][j] = min(d[i][j],hi)
        d[j][i] = min(d[j][i],-lo)
    for k in range(8):
        for i in range(8):
            for j in range(8):
                d[i][j] = min(d[i][j],d[i][k]+d[k][j])
    assert all(d[i][i] >= 0 for i in range(8))
    return d

def tangent(p,pack,lo,hi,side):
    assert points[p][0] == pack and side in ('L','U')
    xp, lo, hi = Q(p,SC), min(lo,Q(p,SC)), max(hi,Q(p,SC))
    k = (p+16384)>>15
    assert k < 16
    ra,rb = Q((region[0]>>(20*k))&1048575,SC),Q((region[1]>>(20*k))&1048575,SC)
    assert ra <= lo <= xp <= hi <= rb
    v,plus,minus = fields(pack)
    assert plus >= 1 and minus >= 1 and plus+minus <= 4*10**9
    dm,dp = Q(plus-2*10**9,10**9),Q(2*10**9-minus,10**9)
    return (dm, Q(v,10**10)-dp*xp+(dp-dm)*lo) if side=='L' else (dp,Q(v,10**10)-dm*xp+(dm-dp)*hi)

def matrix(cell, added, branch=None):
    a=cell['gap_bounds']; cons=constraints(cell)
    ix={(i,j):7+n for n,(i,j,_) in enumerate(terms)}
    obj=list(map(Q,fees+[a for _,_,a in terms])); A=[]; bs=[]
    def row(s,slope,zc,bound):
        vals=[Q(0)]*33
        for t in range(*s): vals[t]=slope
        if zc: vals[ix[s]]=zc
        A.append(vals); bs.append(bound)
    for s,(lo,hi) in cons.items():
        row(s,Q(1),0,Q(hi,5*SC)); row(s,Q(-1),0,-Q(lo,5*SC))
    for (i,j,_),atom in zip(terms,cell['atoms']):
        mode,mi,p,r,l,up,l0,lb,pp,rp=atom
        lo=max(cons[i,j][0]//5,sum(a[2*t] for t in range(i,j)))
        hi=min(cons[i,j][1]//5,sum(a[2*t+1] for t in range(i,j)))
        assert l==lo<=hi
        row((i,j),Q(0),-1,-Q(lb,10**10))
        _,w1,w2=mode_weights(mode,mi)
        for wt,pt,pk in [(w1,p,pp),(w2,r,rp)]:
            if not wt: continue
            v,plus,minus=fields(pk);dm,dp=Q(plus-2*10**9,10**9),Q(2*10**9-minus,10**9)
            assert dm<=dp and lo<=pt<=hi
            xp,L,U,val=Q(pt,SC),Q(lo,SC),Q(hi,SC),Q(v,10**10)
            row((i,j),dm,-1,-(val-dp*xp+(dp-dm)*L))
            row((i,j),dp,-1,-(val-dm*xp+(dm-dp)*U))
    baseline=len(bs)
    box=[(max(Q(4,5),Q(a[2*i],SC)),Q(a[2*i+1],SC)) for i in range(7)]+[(Q(0),Q(1))]*26
    d=None
    if branch:
        d=closure(cell,branch)
        box[:7]=[(max(Q(4,5),Q(-d[i+1][i],5*SC)),Q(d[i][i+1],5*SC)) for i in range(7)]
    for desc in added:
        if branch:
            tag,i,j=desc[:3]
            if tag in ('closure-upper','closure-lower'):
                sign=Q(1) if tag=='closure-upper' else Q(-1)
                row((i,j),sign,0,Q(d[i][j] if sign==1 else d[j][i],5*SC)); continue
            assert tag=='tangent'
            p,pack,n,side=desc[3:]
            lo,hi=Q(-d[j][i],5*SC),Q(d[i][j],5*SC)
        else:
            i,j,p,pack,n,side=desc
            lo=Q(max(cons[i,j][0]//5,sum(a[2*t] for t in range(i,j))),SC)
            hi=Q(min(cons[i,j][1]//5,sum(a[2*t+1] for t in range(i,j))),SC)
        assert points[p]==(pack,n)
        slope,intercept=tangent(p,pack,lo,hi,side)
        row((i,j),slope,-1,-intercept)
    assert all(lo<=hi for lo,hi in box)
    return obj,A,bs,box,baseline

def dual(problem, sparse):
    obj,A,bs,box,*_=problem
    residual=obj[:]; constant=Q(0); seen=set()
    for i,amount in sparse:
        lam=Q(amount)
        assert i not in seen and 0<=i<len(A) and lam>0
        seen.add(i); constant-=lam*bs[i]
        residual=[x+lam*y for x,y in zip(residual,A[i])]
    value=constant+sum(v*(lo if v>=0 else hi) for v,(lo,hi) in zip(residual,box))
    return value/SA

def audit():
    started=time.perf_counter()
    public=[paid(c) for c in old['captured_cells']]
    assert list(map(str,public))==pub['old_ya_lowers']
    formal={}; all_records=[]
    for rec in adapter['records']:
        label=rec['label']; prob=matrix(old['captured_cells'][label],[])
        assert prob[4]==rec['base_rows']; value=dual(prob,rec['dual_sparse'])
        assert value==Q(rec['lower_exact']) and Q(rec['original_YA_exact'])==public[label]
        formal[label]=[value]
        all_records.append({'label':label,'branch':None,'source':'formal_adapter','value':str(value),
            'margin_new_floor':str(value-FLOOR),'public_YA':str(public[label])})
    assert len(formal)==201
    for rec in pub['frame_patches']:
        label=rec['label']; prob=matrix(old['captured_cells'][label],rec['added_rows'])
        assert prob[4]==rec['base_rows']; value=dual(prob,rec['dual_sparse'])
        assert value==Q(rec['lower_exact']); public[label]=value; formal[label]=[value]
        all_records.append({'label':label,'branch':None,'source':'patch','value':str(value),
            'margin_new_floor':str(value-FLOOR)})
    for rec in pub['frame_split_patches']:
        label=rec['label']; d=closure(old['captured_cells'][label]); i,j=rec['span']
        assert rec['original_bounds_5sc']==[-d[j][i],d[i][j]]
        branches=rec['branches']
        assert branches[0]['bounds_5sc'][0]==-d[j][i] and branches[-1]['bounds_5sc'][1]==d[i][j]
        assert all(a['bounds_5sc'][1]==b['bounds_5sc'][0] for a,b in zip(branches,branches[1:]))
        values=[]
        for index,br in enumerate(branches):
            assert not br['empty']
            prob=matrix(old['captured_cells'][label],br['added_rows'],(rec['span'],br['bounds_5sc']))
            assert prob[4]==br['base_rows'];value=dual(prob,br['dual_sparse'])
            assert value==Q(br['lower']);values.append(value)
            all_records.append({'label':label,'branch':index,'source':'split_patch','value':str(value),
                'margin_new_floor':str(value-FLOOR)})
        assert min(values)==Q(rec['lower']);formal[label]=values;public[label]=min(values)
    assert len(formal)==241 and len(all_records)==244
    critical=[r for r in all_records if Q(r['value'])<FLOOR]
    assert {(r['label'],r['branch']) for r in critical}=={(74,None),(183,None),(69,None),(131,None),(17,1)}
    formalmin=min((Q(r['value']),r['label'],r['branch']) for r in all_records)
    adaptermin=min((Q(r['value']),r['label']) for r in all_records if r['source']=='formal_adapter')
    publicmin=min((v,i) for i,v in enumerate(public))
    strong=Q(pub['strong_reward']);pairmin=Q(32992055894668884928258784247,4096000000000000000000000000000)
    assert (strong+FLOOR)/2==TARGET and pairmin>TARGET
    report={'scope':'independent exact stored witnesses; no author imports, optimization, Lean or actual-zeta upper',
      'pins':{str(p):sha(p) for p in [Path(__file__),ROOT/'output/am-joint-frame-pair-certificate.json',
        ROOT/'output/am-expanded-nine-point-certificate.json',FORMAL/'output/am-joint-frame-ya-adapter.json',
        ROOT/'scripts/am_lossless_majorant_certificate.py']},
      'target_floor':str(FLOOR),'target_reward':str(TARGET),'target_ratio':str(Q(66812491,SA)/(1-TARGET)),
      'stored_formal_cases':244,'adapter_cases':201,'adapter_minimum':{'label':adaptermin[1],'value':str(adaptermin[0]),'margin':str(adaptermin[0]-FLOOR)},
      'public_minimum':{'label':publicmin[1],'value':str(publicmin[0])},
      'formal_minimum':{'label':formalmin[1],'branch':formalmin[2],'value':str(formalmin[0])},
      'public_insufficient_labels':[i for i,v in enumerate(public) if v<FLOOR],
      'formal_insufficient_cases':critical,'pair_minimum_from_previous_independent_full_check':str(pairmin),
      'pair_margin':str(pairmin-TARGET),'records':all_records,'elapsed_seconds':time.perf_counter()-started}
    (WORK/'stored-outer-audit.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
    print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in report.items() if k not in ('records','pins')},indent=2))

if __name__=='__main__': audit()

independent_new_frame_audit.py.script_source:
"""Independent Fraction reconstruction of round506 targeted closed covers.

No author generator/checker is imported or executed. The unchanged baseline
row semantics are supplied by this reviewer's own independent matrix code.
"""
from fractions import Fraction as Q
from pathlib import Path
import json,time
import independent_outer_audit as base

def exact_closure(cell,span=None,bounds=None,theta=False):
    d=[[0 if i==j else 10**30 for j in range(8)] for i in range(8)]
    for (i,j),(lo,hi) in base.constraints(cell).items():
        d[i][j]=min(d[i][j],hi);d[j][i]=min(d[j][i],-lo)
    if theta:
        for i in range(7):d[i+1][i]=min(d[i+1][i],-4*base.SC)
    if span is not None:
        i,j=span;lo,hi=bounds
